Control Objective: Ensure access is authorized appropriate and removed when no longer required
Key Evidence: Access requests manager approvals user inventory termination records
Gap Identified: Recurring access reviews and offboarding evidence are inconsistent
Recommended Remediation: Perform quarterly access reviews and strengthen automated termination access removal

Control Objective: Limit elevated access to approved users with documented business need
Key Evidence: Privileged account inventory business justification review approvals
Gap Identified: Some privileged accounts lack current justification and review evidence
Recommended Remediation: Perform quarterly privileged access reviews and remove unnecessary elevated permissions

Control Objective: Require stronger authentication for applicable privileged remote and sensitive access
Key Evidence: MFA enrollment reports authentication configuration exception approvals
Gap Identified: MFA coverage is incomplete for some privileged accounts
Recommended Remediation: Enforce MFA for all applicable accounts and formally document approved exceptions

Control Objective: Ensure personnel receive recurring security awareness education
Key Evidence: Training completion reports awareness materials acknowledgment records
Gap Identified: No major gap identified
Recommended Remediation: Continue recurring awareness training and retain completion evidence

Control Objective: Ensure security relevant events are logged reviewed investigated and retained
Key Evidence: SIEM reports log source inventory review records incident tickets
Gap Identified: Recurring log review evidence is inconsistent
Recommended Remediation: Define recurring log review procedures and retain reviewer investigation and escalation evidence

Control Objective: Ensure production changes are authorized tested documented and approved
Key Evidence: Change requests testing records approvals implementation logs
Gap Identified: Some change records lack complete testing evidence
Recommended Remediation: Require testing and approval evidence before implementation

Control Objective: Identify prioritize remediate and track vulnerabilities using risk based timelines
Key Evidence: Vulnerability scan reports aging reports remediation tickets risk acceptance records
Gap Identified: High risk vulnerabilities may exceed target timelines
Recommended Remediation: Enforce severity based remediation SLAs and formal exception approval

Control Objective: Ensure incidents are identified escalated contained documented and reviewed
Key Evidence: Incident response plan tickets investigation records escalation records lessons learned
Gap Identified: Documentation quality varies across incidents
Recommended Remediation: Standardize incident documentation and closure review

Control Objective: Validate incident response procedures through recurring exercises
Key Evidence: Tabletop reports participant lists lessons learned corrective action tracker
Gap Identified: Current testing evidence is incomplete
Recommended Remediation: Conduct annual tabletop exercises and track corrective actions through closure

Control Objective: Identify assess prioritize and manage cybersecurity and compliance risk
Key Evidence: Risk register risk assessments treatment plans approvals
Gap Identified: Some risk records lack complete treatment documentation
Recommended Remediation: Require risk owners treatment decisions target dates and management approval

Control Objective: Assess and monitor vendor security and compliance risk
Key Evidence: Vendor questionnaires assessments contracts reassessment records remediation tracker
Gap Identified: High risk vendors are not always reassessed on schedule
Recommended Remediation: Establish annual reassessment requirements for high risk vendors

Control Objective: Protect sensitive information during transmission and storage where appropriate
Key Evidence: TLS settings encryption standards key management evidence configuration screenshots
Gap Identified: No major gap identified
Recommended Remediation: Maintain approved encryption standards and periodic configuration reviews

Control Objective: Ensure critical systems and data can be restored following disruption
Key Evidence: Backup reports restore tests recovery logs failure tickets
Gap Identified: Restoration testing is inconsistent
Recommended Remediation: Perform quarterly restoration tests and retain recovery evidence

Control Objective: Ensure policies are documented approved communicated and periodically reviewed
Key Evidence: Policies approvals revision history review schedules
Gap Identified: Some policies exceed scheduled review dates
Recommended Remediation: Implement centralized policy review tracking and automated reminders

Control Objective: Maintain an accurate inventory of systems applications devices and information assets
Key Evidence: Asset inventory ownership records classifications lifecycle records
Gap Identified: Some applications are not consistently inventoried or classified
Recommended Remediation: Perform recurring inventory reconciliation and assign ownership and classification

Control Objective: Establish accountability and controls for handling personal information
Key Evidence: Privacy policies data inventory lawful basis records DPIAs privacy notices
Gap Identified: Privacy specific requirements are not fully integrated into the common control environment
Recommended Remediation: Create dedicated privacy governance procedures and map privacy obligations separately

Control Objective: Retain information only as required and securely dispose of it when no longer needed
Key Evidence: Retention schedule deletion records disposal procedures legal hold records
Gap Identified: Retention rules vary by data type and are inconsistently documented
Recommended Remediation: Create a centralized retention schedule with owners disposal rules and review dates

Control Objective: Periodically validate that user and privileged access remains appropriate
Key Evidence: Access certification reports manager approvals removal records
Gap Identified: Some review findings lack closure evidence
Recommended Remediation: Require documented remediation evidence before access review closure

Control Objective: Track identified weaknesses through corrective action validation and closure
Key Evidence: POA&M audit findings corrective action plans validation evidence closure approvals
Gap Identified: Some findings may close without sufficient validation evidence
Recommended Remediation: Require independent validation and formal approval before closure

Control Objective: Maintain organized reliable and retrievable compliance evidence
Key Evidence: Evidence repository indexes naming standards approval records audit artifacts
Gap Identified: Evidence is stored across multiple locations
Recommended Remediation: Centralize evidence storage and establish naming ownership and retention standards
